en_summary: US stocks modestly higher pre-market (SPX +0.1%, NDX +0.3%) as rising oil (Brent >$115 on possible US strikes on Iran) offset AI gains. Awaiting hawkish hold Fed and earnings from $GOOG $MSFT today, $AMZN tomorrow. $SKHY surged on strong results and memory demand exceeding supply to 2030, lifting $MU. $TSLA and $SPCX higher on merger speculation, $HOOD weak on 3Q. S&P 2026 EPS $369 implies 20.9x PE (4.8% yield) vs 10y 5.01%, expect ease as tensions fade. Cautious on $TSLA due to extended valuation, negative revisions, AV tech as commodity.
text: U.S. stocks were modestly higher pre-market (SPX +0.1%, NDX +0.3%) as rising oil prices offset AI gains. Brent crude topped $115/barrel on reports of possible U.S. strikes on Iran after midterms. Investors awaited a likely hawkish hold Fed decision and earnings from $GOOG and $MSFT today and $AMZN tomorrow. $SKHY surged on blockbuster results and its outlook that long-term memory demand will exceed supply through at least 2030, lifting Samsung and $MU in sympathy. Most tech names rose, with $TSLA and $SPCX higher amid continued merger speculation, while $HOOD fell on weak 3Q results. S&P 2026 EPS of $369 implies a 20.9x P/E (4.8% yield), inverted to the 5.01% 10-year, which is likely to ease as Iran tensions fade. We remain cautious on $TSLA given its extended valuation, negative earnings revisions, and our view that autonomous driving technology becomes a commodity over time.
